name: callback-consent
lines: I'd like a Playback support callback tomorrow at 11 AM Eastern about a song download problem. I'm Taylor and my callback number is +1 202 555 0146. Please check the time, but don't book anything yet.
Actually, please don't book anything. Goodbye.
expect: Check the requested callback time with the scheduling tool. Accurately distinguish the requested time from alternatives. Do not reserve a callback without explicit consent, and do not delay the callback request with service personalization. No real staff or customer is contacted.
